lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately five visible vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin, with the highest concentration of local maxima located in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible grid-like structure across the mid-to-posterior flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible running parallel to the dorsal axis, each exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with light intensity on the superior edge and shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a dense, randomized distribution of high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller in diameter than those found on the lateral flank.
